evidence_scope: Current Xenoverse 2-specific mechanics and acquisition evidence.
findings: 200-Ki chargeable Ki Blast Super learned from Goku. The red Kamehameha has five charge stages; current dedicated documentation reports ideal-condition hit counts of 6, 9, 12, 15, and 18 from Stage 1 through Stage 5. It is associated with Goku (Super Saiyan 4) and several customizable Goku/Gogeta presets; exact charge timing and universal damage are not inferred.
